about: A transmissive look is one fade. previewOpacity.test.js holds previewOpacity.js and the viewer's xbf look to these numbers; the engine's test_materials.py holds formats/gltf.py's preview_alpha, export/glb.py's _alpha, threejs_materials' interpolate_color, the OCCT still's finish and the 3MF an xbf exports (export/threemf.py: its colour's alpha byte, displayAlpha, whatever the colour's own alpha) to the same ones.

previewCases.why: a transmissive look at alpha 1 previews as build123d's setter infers
an alpha below 1 is the look's own fade
no transmission: the alpha as it is
no transmission, faded: the alpha as it is

lookCases.why: PMMA: opaque in a GLB, 0.58 where no transmission is drawn
an opacity of 1 is no fade
an author's fade is the alpha either way
an author's fade on clear glass
